entries.notes: Vendored at the pinned commit, then locally edited (comments and echo messages only, no logic change) to drop references to sibling-repo files (docs/environment.md, rtl/modexp.v, sibling issue numbers); sha256 values are of the local edited files. openroad-docker.sh is taken because setup-env.sh symlinks it as the openroad fallback; on this host the PATH openroad wrapper does not forward PLATFORM_DIR, so the docker wrapper is the working route. The sibling's OpenROAD smoke test (a script plus fixture directory under scripts/) was first vendored here, then removed per the operator ruling on 2AMLogic/sky130-adpll#42: flow/smoke is the single toolchain proof. Not taken: scripts/spice_lef_parsing.py (unrelated), docs/environment.md and verification/check_pins.py (the setup script's comments point at them; this repo records pins in flow/smoke/records/environment.json instead).

Harness shape only (cocotb DUT helpers, record checker, gate-level pattern). No file content is vendored; the runner and checker here are new and much smaller. verification/gate-level/ takes the sibling's SHAPE -- a committed sky130_fd_sc_hd_sim_defines.v listed first on the source list, plus a wrapper script -- but not its content: run-gate-level.sh is written against this repo's verification/run_tests.py rather than the sibling's `klt functional-verification` request JSON, and the defines DIVERGE on UNIT_DELAY. The sibling defines it as `#1` to work around Icarus leaving D_delayed/CLK_delayed undriven under the timing arm; measured here (2AMLogic/sky130-adpll#70, Icarus 13.0): that all-x failure does not reproduce, and `#1` instead fails test_top.py:37 on seeds 12345/777/20260114 because test_top's tick() samples 1 ns after each ref_clk edge, exactly when a #1 flop output transitions. This repo defines UNIT_DELAY empty (zero delay). Pins to be revisited with the environment pin (#3).
